approved_by: PROJECT_OWNER, independently reviewed by GPT (relayed in chat 2026-09-07)
allowed_paths_create: requirements-collector.txt -- ONLY if the bounded dependency-manifest lookup at repo root finds no existing requirements*.txt / pyproject.toml / Pipfile; if one already exists, that exact existing file is modified instead and this 6th file slot is NOT used
out_of_scope_findings_policy: default NON_BLOCKING_BACKLOG; zero additional investigation this changeset
readiness_tool_consolidation: All new validation logic (gap-ledger semantic validation, repair/resync provenance validation, soak-summary validation, formal-Dataset startup-gate evaluation) lives in a single new read-only tool, EvidenceHunter_collector_readiness.py, with its tests in tests/test_collector_readiness.py. No separate validator scripts are created. Because tests/test_collector_supervisor.py etc. are in forbidden_paths this round, the G1 thread-crash-observability tests also live in tests/test_collector_readiness.py rather than in the (already-committed, out-of-scope-to-touch) existing test files.

g1_thread_crash_observability.requirement: If a component's run_component_lifecycle background thread exits via an uncaught exception, the Supervisor must become aware within a bounded time, the component must stop showing a stale HEALTHY/STREAM_NOT_READY state, it must explicitly enter a new STATE_LIFECYCLE_THREAD_CRASHED state, an incident must be recorded (via the existing alert_fn + persisted supervisor_state.json mechanism -- no new incident-storage mechanism), and it must never continue silently.

required_measurements: process RSS periodic samples (via OS/PowerShell process info only, no psutil dependency)
process CPU-time delta (via OS/PowerShell process info only, no psutil dependency)
soak_test_policy.evaluation_target: storage growth is measurable; no unbounded queue growth observed; writer keeps pace; resource usage shows no obvious monotonic runaway -- this is NOT a fixed GB/day pass/fail threshold; formal capacity planning happens later from the measured values
soak_test_policy.disposition: KEEP_UNTIL_EVENT = READINESS_EVIDENCE_RECORDED; deleted only after the formal Readiness report is generated; if READINESS=FAIL, keep until blockers are resolved
soak_test_policy.no_recovery_of_deleted_prior_smoke_evide: the two OS %TEMP% directories from NEXT_DATASET_COLLECTOR_IMPLEMENTATION's live smoke tests were already deleted after that changeset closed and are NOT to be recreated or investigated; this changeset's own soak run plus synthetic fault/replay against already-committed raw evidence are the evidence inputs

restart_recovery_test_policy.allowed_kill_command: Stop-Process -Id <exact PID of the readiness collector process started this changeset> -Force
must_demonstrate: the prior persisted supervisor_state.json is diagnostic evidence only and is never used to silently resume a component into HEALTHY
every component in the restarted process begins again at CONNECTING -> STREAM_NOT_READY -> HEALTHY
the diff-depth order book performs a fresh REST snapshot + resync after restart, not a resume of the old in-memory book
the interruption window is represented as an explicit gap/provenance record, not silently absent

dependency_freeze_policy.bounded_manifest_lookup_scope: repo root only (D:\EvidenceHunter), not a full-repo scan
dependency_freeze_policy.if_existing_manifest_found: modify that exact existing file to add websocket-client==1.9.2; do not create requirements-collector.txt
dependency_freeze_policy.if_no_existing_manifest_found: may create requirements-collector.txt (uses the 6th of 6 MAX_NEW_FILES; if unused, the file budget for this changeset is 5, not 6 -- an unused slot must never be spent on anything else)
dependency_freeze_policy.no_full_venv_freeze: do not freeze/pin the full transitive dependency set of the .venv

formal_dataset_startup_gate.on_any_gate_fail: overall readiness = FAIL with an explicit blockers list; a future changeset creating a formal Dataset must first read this report and confirm readiness == PASS

prohibited_this_round: 168h or any long-running unattended live collection start
